description:
The Relation Grid's ask protocol (RFC 0050 · Episode 2, ext4 and ext5).
        Every question the grid asks and every answer it accepts is declared
        ONCE, as a Java record, and its JS class is GENERATED from that record
        at build time. Nothing about a payload's shape is written twice.

        Per the Generated and Hand-Written Live Apart doctrine this module's
        src/main/resources is empty: the served JS is produced by
        RelGridProtocolGen.main() into target/classes during process-classes,
        under the filename the DomModule's simple name requires.

        Data only — no DOM, no grid. Domain code depends on this to answer
        without depending on the grid, which is ext4's law 202.

        Round one carries the first kind: a selection notification, which
        expects no answer. Codecs are not generated, because nothing serialises
        one yet (law 214).
